name: Estival-Spire
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a binary sunset.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in carbon here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
